title: Jobs
lead: The releases you sent to a download client, followed there until they finish. Only your own jobs are listed.

tabs.label: Jobs by what they wait for

emptyTab.NeedsYou: Nothing waits for you: every job moves on by itself or has ended.

overwriteCheck.NotCheckedMagnet: Not checked for files it would write over: a magnet link names its files only once the client has fetched them.
overwriteCheck.NotCheckedFileList: Not checked for files it would write over: the app couldn't read the .torrent's list of files.
overwriteCheck.NotCheckedFolderUnknown: Not checked for files it would write over: the destination's folder had no path in the app.
overwriteCheck.NotCheckedFolderOutsideMediaFolders: Not checked for files it would write over: the destination's folder wasn't under Media folders, or a link in it led out of them.
overwriteCheck.NotCheckedClientJobs: Not checked for files it would write over: the download client couldn't list the torrents it already had there, or their files.
overwriteCheck.NotCheckedFileName: Not checked for files it would write over: a file's name held characters the app couldn't look up.

replacement.scheduled_one: Replacement scheduled: {{value}} copy, kept until the new one is verified.
replacement.scheduled_other: Replacement scheduled: {{value}} copies, kept until the new one is verified.
replacement.switchedOff: Replacement scheduled, but replacement is switched off: nothing will move while it is off.
replacement.outsideTickedFolders_one: {{value}} copy is no longer in a ticked folder: unless it is ticked again, the replacement stops for review and nothing moves.
replacement.outsideTickedFolders_other: {{value}} copies are no longer in a ticked folder: unless they are ticked again, the replacement stops for review and nothing moves.
replacement.checking_one: Replacement checks the new file: {{value}} copy, kept until it is verified.
replacement.checking_other: Replacement checks the new file: {{value}} copies, kept until it is verified.
replacement.checkingSwitchedOff: Replacement checks the new file, but replacement is switched off: nothing will move while it is off.
replacement.checkingLibrary_one: Replacement waits for Jellyfin to identify the new file until {{time}}: {{value}} copy, kept until it is verified.
replacement.checkingLibrary_other: Replacement waits for Jellyfin to identify the new files until {{time}}: {{value}} copies, kept until they are verified.
replacement.verified_one: New file verified: {{value}} old copy moves into the quarantine next.
replacement.verified_other: New file verified: {{value}} old copies move into the quarantine next.
replacement.verifiedSwitchedOff: New file verified, but replacement is switched off: nothing will move while it is off.
replacement.verifiedOutside_one: New file verified, but {{value}} copy is no longer in a ticked folder: unless it is ticked again, the replacement stops for review and nothing moves.
replacement.verifiedOutside_other: New file verified, but {{value}} copies are no longer in a ticked folder: unless they are ticked again, the replacement stops for review and nothing moves.
replacement.quarantining_one: Moving the old copy into the quarantine…
replacement.quarantining_other: Moving the old copies into the quarantine…
replacement.quarantined_one: Old copy moved into the quarantine: {{value}} copy, kept until you restore it or delete it for good.
replacement.quarantined_other: Old copies moved into the quarantine: {{value}} copies, kept until you restore them or delete them for good.
replacement.stayed_one: {{value}} file stayed in its folder: see the job.
replacement.stayed_other: {{value}} files stayed in their folders: see the job.
replacement.deleting_one: Deleting the old copy for good…
replacement.deleting_other: Deleting the old copies for good…
replacement.restored_one: Replacement undone: the old copy is back where it was.
replacement.restored_other: Replacement undone: the old copies are back where they were.
replacement.completed_one: Replaced: the old copy was deleted for good.
replacement.completed_other: Replaced: the old copies were deleted for good.

next.Download: Keep both, or cancel the job.
next.Check: Fix it in Jellyfin or {{client}}, then press Retry — or see the job.
next.dropOnly_one: {{value}} copy can only be dropped, or both kept: see the job.
next.dropOnly_other: {{value}} copies can only be dropped, or both kept: see the job.
next.dropOnlyKeepBoth_one: A new check can't pair its last copy: keep both.
next.dropOnlyKeepBoth_other: A new check can't pair any of its {{value}} copies left: keep both.

cancel.title: Cancel the job for {{title}}?
cancel.message: The app stops following this download and never asks {{client}} about it again. The torrent and its files stay in {{client}}: nothing is paused, stopped or removed there. This can't be undone; to follow the release again, send it again from Search.

actionFailed: Could not cancel this job. Reload the page and try again.

oldCopies.title: Replacement
oldCopies.notOwner: Only the installation owner sees a replacement's copies and checks, and retries, cancels or drops them.
oldCopies.loadFailed: Could not load the old copies.
oldCopies.refreshFailed: Refresh failed, showing the old copies as last loaded.
oldCopies.noneYet: No old copy has moved yet: each moves into the quarantine once the new file is verified.
oldCopies.noneYetSwitchedOff: No old copy has moved yet, and none moves while replacement is switched off.
oldCopies.noneMoved: Nothing of this replacement was moved.
oldCopies.room_one: The quarantine holds {{size}} of this replacement, in {{value}} file.
oldCopies.room_other: The quarantine holds {{size}} of this replacement, in {{value}} files.
oldCopies.roomEmpty: Nothing of this replacement is in the quarantine.
oldCopies.switchedOff: Replacement is switched off on the Media folders page: nothing is put back or deleted while it is off.
oldCopies.otherNames: It has another name (a hardlink), so deleting it frees no space.

state.Lost: Found neither where it was nor in the quarantine.

next.Download: The app can't follow this download, so its new file can't be checked. Keep both cancels only the replacement; Cancel job stops following the download. Both copies stay either way.
next.Check: Fix what the reason says — for a film Jellyfin gave no id, set its TMDb link on the Library page, and Jellyfin's Identify applies it —, then press Retry: the check starts again, and Jellyfin's ids decide. Or drop a copy below: it stays where it is. Or keep both.
next.CheckNoDrop: Fix what the reason says — for a film Jellyfin gave no id, set its TMDb link on the Library page, and Jellyfin's Identify applies it —, then press Retry: the check starts again, and Jellyfin's ids decide. Or keep both.
next.dropOnly_one: {{value}} copy can only be dropped, or both copies kept: a new check can't pair it. Drop it below, then press Retry for the others.
next.dropOnly_other: {{value}} copies can only be dropped, or both copies kept: a new check can't pair them. Drop them below, then press Retry for the others.
next.dropOnlyKeepBoth_one: Only keeping both settles this: a new check can't pair the replacement's last copy, and the last copy can't be dropped.
next.dropOnlyKeepBoth_other: Only keeping both settles this: a new check can't pair any of the {{value}} copies left, and the last copy can't be dropped.
next.Move: Remove what holds the copy — a torrent goes in the download client that lists it, without its files —, or fix what the reason says, then press Retry. Or drop that copy below: it stays where it is, and the others move. Or keep both.
next.MoveRestore: Remove what holds the copy — a torrent goes in the download client that lists it, without its files —, or fix what the reason says, then press Retry. Or drop that copy below: it stays where it is, and the others move. Restore puts back what is in the quarantine.
next.MoveNoDrop: Remove what holds the copy — a torrent goes in the download client that lists it, without its files —, or fix what the reason says, then press Retry. Or keep both.
next.MoveRestoreNoDrop: Remove what holds the copy — a torrent goes in the download client that lists it, without its files —, or fix what the reason says, then press Retry. Restore puts back what is in the quarantine.
next.switchedOff: Replacement is switched off on the Media folders page: nothing moves while it is off. Switch it on there, or keep both.

check.starting: The check of the new files starts within a few seconds.
check.files: Reading the new files on the disk (started {{time}}).
check.libraryWait: Waiting for Jellyfin to identify the new files until {{time}}.
check.verified: Every old copy is paired with a new file Jellyfin identified.

copies.title: Old copies and their new files
copies.summary_one: Nothing moves until every copy is paired or dropped: {{paired}} of {{value}} paired, {{dropped}} dropped.
copies.summary_other: Nothing moves until every copy is paired or dropped: {{paired}} of {{value}} paired, {{dropped}} dropped.
copies.pairedLater: Paired once Jellyfin has identified every new file.
copies.onlyDrop: Only dropping it or keeping both settles this.

status.Dropped: Dropped from the replacement: it stays where it is.
status.Waiting: Kept until the new file is verified.
status.Paired: Paired with its new file: it moves into the quarantine when the replacement goes ahead.
status.Lost: Found neither where it was nor in the quarantine.

progress.NotChecked: Not read on the disk yet.
progress.AskedToLook: Jellyfin asked to look at it.
progress.NoId: No TMDb or IMDb id from Jellyfin yet.
progress.NotNumbered: No season and episode number from Jellyfin yet.

retry.title: Check the old copies again, and move them once nothing stands in the way
retry.done: Retried: the app checks the old copies again and moves them once nothing stands in the way.
retry.titleCheck: Check the new files again: Jellyfin's ids decide whether the old copies move
retry.doneCheck: Retried: the app checks the new files again and asks Jellyfin to look at them again.
retry.blockedByDrop: Drop the copies a new check can't pair first, or keep both.
retry.blockedKeepBoth: A new check can't pair the copies left, and the last copy can't be dropped: keep both instead.
retry.failed: Could not retry this replacement. Reload the page and try again.

keepBoth.title: Cancel only the replacement: both copies stay, and the download goes on
keepBoth.message_one: The replacement is cancelled: the old copy stays where it is, and nothing of it moves. The download is left as it is, and nothing is sent to {{client}}. This can't be undone.
keepBoth.message_other: The replacement is cancelled: the {{value}} old copies stay where they are, and nothing of them moves. The download is left as it is, and nothing is sent to {{client}}. This can't be undone.

drop.title: Take this copy out of the replacement: it stays where it is
drop.message: It stays where it is, and nothing of it moves. A new file it was paired with is simply added once Jellyfin has identified it. Press Retry afterwards to go on with the other copies.
drop.done: Dropped “{{name}}”: it stays where it is.
drop.lastCopy: It is the replacement's last copy: keep both instead.

restore.title: Put the old copies in the quarantine back where they were
restore.message: Every file of this replacement in the quarantine goes back where it was, never over a file there now, and no folder is created for it. The new copy stays as it is. Jellyfin lists the old copy again and identifies it afresh, so a TMDb link you set by hand may need Identify again.
restore.done_one: Restored: {{value}} file is back where it was.
restore.done_other: Restored: {{value}} files are back where they were.
restore.failed: Could not put the old copies back. Reload the page and try again.

deleteForGood.title: Delete the old copies in the quarantine for good
deleteForGood.confirmTitle_one: Delete the old copy for good?
deleteForGood.confirmTitle_other: Delete the old copies for good?
deleteForGood.lead_one: This file is deleted from the quarantine, and can't be restored afterwards:
deleteForGood.lead_other: These {{value}} files are deleted from the quarantine, and can't be restored afterwards:
deleteForGood.otherNames_one: {{value}} file has another name (a hardlink), so deleting it frees no space.
deleteForGood.otherNames_other: {{value}} files have another name (a hardlink), so deleting them frees no space.
deleteForGood.failed: Could not delete the old copies. Reload the page and try again.

loadFailed: Could not load your download jobs.
refreshFailed: Refresh failed, showing the last loaded jobs.
empty: No download jobs yet. Send a release from <search>Search</search>, and it is followed here until it finishes.

details.notFound: There is no download job of yours at this address. It may belong to someone else, or the link is wrong.
details.loadFailed: Could not load this download job.
details.refreshFailed: Refresh failed, showing what was last loaded.
details.clientJobIdUnknown: Not listed by the client yet

files.title: Files
files.skippedTitle: Skipped in the download client: it isn't downloaded.
files.loadFailed: Could not load this job's files.
files.refreshFailed: Refresh failed, showing the last loaded files.
files.empty: The download client hasn't listed this download's files yet. A magnet link lists them once its metadata has arrived.

summary.restored_one: Undone: the old copy is back
summary.restored_other: Undone: the old copies are back
